note: Literature reports show dissociated reflex patterns (absent ankle jerks with preserved patellar reflexes or brisk reflexes) in SPTAN1-associated neuromuscular phenotypes.

evidence.text: In a family investigated for a novel SPTAN1 variant presenting with distal motor myopathy with nerve involvement, deep tendon reflexes were absent across the limbs except for the patellar reflex.

source.title: DISTAL MYOPATHIES: EP. 75 Functional validation of a novel variant of the SPTAN1 gene identified in a family with distal motor myopathy with nerve involvement
source.quote: Deep tendon reflexes are absent in the four limbs, except for the patellar … in SPTAN1 and DYNC1H1.

evidence.text: A patient harboring a SPTAN1 variant demonstrated absent ankle reflexes while knee reflexes remained present.

source.title: SPTAN1 variants likely cause autosomal recessive complicated hereditary spastic paraplegia
source.quote: Ankle reflexes were absent while knee reflexes were present.
